sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Dharm Singh Parmar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Pachori,J.
Sri Dharm Singh Parmar, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Pankaj Kumar Rai, learned A.G.A. for the State are present.
Despite service of notice none has appeared for the opposite party nos. 2 and 3.

The present transfer application has been filed to transfer the Sessions Trial No. 185 of 2018 (State vs. Ram Narayan and another), under Section 498A, 304B, 328 IPC and Sectin 3/4 D.P.Act, pending in the court of Sessions Judge, Kanpur Dehat (Ramabai Nagar) to the competent court of Hamirpur Judgeship.

entities.text: Sessions Trial No. 185 of 2018 (State vs. Ram Narayan and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the opposite party nos. 2 and 3 are accused in the above noted case.

It is further submitted that the applicant has apprehension of assault by the Uma Kant vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9276697/
1 opposite party nos. 2 and 3.

entities.text: Uma Kant vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that four prosecution witnesses have been examined in the above noted case.
Learned counsel for the opposite party nos. 2 and 3 has vehemently opposed the prayer of this application.
In view of the above facts and circumstances of the case, this transfer application has no merit and deserves to be dismissed.
Accordingly, this transfer application is dismissed.
